description.value: Country Grocer is a family-owned Vancouver Island supermarket chain with over four decades of history, emphasizing locally sourced produce, meats, and freshly baked goods. The Duncan location sits at Berkey's Corner in North Cowichan, where Cowichan Lake Road, Somenos Road, and Sherman Road converge — a natural stopping point for cyclists heading into the Cowichan Valley. The store offers a broad selection of local BC products alongside full deli, bakery, and seafood departments.
